query:
UPDATE artists SET
                mbid      = COALESCE(artists.mbid, $2),
                image_url = CASE WHEN artists.image_locked THEN artists.image_url
                                 WHEN $4 THEN COALESCE($3, artists.image_url)
                                 ELSE COALESCE(artists.image_url, $3) END
            WHERE id = $1
